task.goal: A log collector receives UTF-8 NDJSON in arbitrary byte chunks. Its parser sometimes loses records when a chunk ends in the middle of a UTF-8 character or a line. Fix the parser in stream_records.py without changing its public function. Run the visible tests, add a focused regression test if useful, and validate the fix. Do not edit benchmark metadata; only this copied project is your workspace.

result.text:
I'll start by inspecting the project.The parser now keeps partial UTF-8 sequences across chunk boundaries via an incremental decoder, so no bytes are discarded mid-character; `parse_records(chunks)` keeps its signature and behavior for complete lines and a trailing unterminated line.

Validation: `python3 -m unittest -v test_stream_records` → 7 tests OK, including new regressions covering every two-way split of a multi-record multibyte stream, a character split across three chunks, one-byte-per-chunk framing, and a final record without a trailing newline.
